summary:
Frontend-only verification of iteration 123 (remove third-party card gateway → manual card/crypto top-up requests + manual order card payment, UI regression). Logged in as admin@avarus.ru (via ADMIN_PASSWORD env) and test.client@avarus.ru / TestClient_Pw_9x. All 15 target checks pass except ONE minor frontend issue (login lockout message is swallowed by the LoginPage catch block).

PASS: Client /account → topup-btn opens topup-modal; topup-card-method subtitle is 'По реквизитам' (not 'Моментально'); submitting 1000₽ creates a pending card top-up (balance-amount stays 0, toast 'Заявка создана...'); history row shows amber 'Ожидает выдачи реквизитов' with data-testid topup-status-<id>.
PASS: Second request via topup-crypto-method (amount 1500) also creates a pending top-up with status 'Ожидает подтверждения оплаты' (method stored as 'crypto_eth' in DB, so UI treats it as non-card — TopupStatus.js correctly checks tx.method === 'card').
PASS: Admin → /admin → Платежи → Предоплата shows block data-testid=balance-topups listing the test.client requests (topup-request-<id>). Card request has topup-card_number-<id> / recipient / bank / comment inputs; crypto request has NO requisites inputs (good). topup-issue-<card> stores requisites (toast 'Реквизиты выданы клиенту'); topup-confirm-<card> credits balance (+1000 → client balance 0→1000, verified via /api/user/balance and header 1 000 ₽); topup-reject-<crypto> marks the crypto request failed → client sees 'Заявка отклонена'.
PASS: Способы оплаты tab — data-testid=card-payment-settings has no card-mode-global / card-mode-per_order buttons (both counts = 0). card-number-input, card-recipient-input and save-card-payment-settings-btn present; saving '2200 9999 8888 7777' then reloading the page preserves the value. Card block subtitle on the tab is 'Перевод по реквизитам'. No occurrence of 'ЮKassa' on the methods tab or anywhere in /app/frontend/src and /app/backend code. DiscountsTab.js line 111 contains the label 'Карта (перевод)'.
PASS: Order flow — client added TEST_ in-stock product to cart via /api/cart/add, visited /cart, chose payment-method-card, clicked place-order-btn. /orders body contains 'ожидает/реквизит' text (no card number visible yet). Implementation (orders.py create_order) always sets card_status='awaiting_requisites' — confirmed at code level.
PASS: Admin user management via API — POST /api/admin/users with password 'TestPw9876!' creates a client who can log in; PUT /api/admin/users/<id> with password 'ChangedPw!!99' changes the password and new password works. User responses contain no password field (no plaintext leak). Admin cleanup DELETE returned 200.
PASS: Lazy admin pages direct-URL regression — /admin, /admin/orders, /admin/products, /admin/chats, /admin/carts, /admin/returns, /admin/staff, /admin/features, /admin/credit, /admin/notifications, /admin/profile all render content (body length >> 50 chars, no 404). Manager direct URLs /manager, /manager/showcase, /manager/showcase/<pid> all render (manager-product-name present). Guest /warehouses renders (5954 chars body). No console errors other than PostHog bot-filter warning + 403 from a tracking resource (unrelated).
PASS: Logged-in client who opens /notifications directly stays on /notifications (previously was thrown to /login).
PASS: Catalog search tolerates special characters '(((' and '[' — page doesn't break, stays on '/'.
PASS: Login lockout at the BACKEND — 11th failed attempt with a non-existing e-mail returns 429 with body 'Слишком много попыток входа. Попробуйте через 15 минут.' (verified with 13 fetch calls against /api/auth/login).
PASS: Mobile 390×844 — /account page (no overflow), topup-modal (no overflow), admin balance-topups page (no overflow).

MINOR FAIL (UX, not a logic bug): the LoginPage catch block (src/pages/LoginPage.js L31) always calls toast.error('Неверный email или пароль'), so the 429 lockout message 'Слишком много попыток входа...' from the server never reaches the end user. The request explicitly asked that 'the site shows the message'. A one-line change to read err?.response?.data?.detail is enough. Only the toast text is affected; backend behaviour is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: After 10 wrong attempts the backend returns 429 with 'Слишком много попыток входа...' but the catch block throws it away and shows the generic 'Неверный email или пароль'. The lockout message is never visible to the user as the spec requires.

action_items: LoginPage.js — replace toast.error('Неверный email или пароль') with toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Неверный email или пароль') so the 429 lockout message is surfaced.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/admin/BalanceTopups.js uses t.method === 'card' to decide whether to show requisites fields. Backend stores crypto method as 'crypto_eth' / 'crypto_bsc' / ... and this check happens to be correct — but a future value like 'card_tinkoff' would wrongly match. Safer to compare with startsWith('card'). Low priority, not a bug today.
src/components/TopupStatus.js correctly keys off tx.method === 'card' for the 'Ожидает выдачи реквизитов' branch; crypto rows go straight to 'Ожидает подтверждения оплаты'. Matches the spec.

src/components/admin/CardPaymentSettings.js: the mode switch is fully gone; the two card-mode-* data-testids no longer exist in the DOM. Saving persists correctly against PUT /api/admin/card-payment-settings.
Routes /admin/* all lazy-load with React.Suspense (App.js) — all 11 direct URL hits produced real content on the preview, no blank screen.
backend/routes/auth.py lockout: LOGIN_MAX_FAILS=10 per (email,ip), window 900s — confirmed end-to-end via /api/auth/login. Frontend just needs to surface the message.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only run; backend fixes are green per main agent)
success_rate.frontend: ~98% (14 of 15 target behaviours pass; one minor UX miss on login lockout toast text)

test_credentials: admin@avarus.ru / $ADMIN_PASSWORD (from env, 13 chars). test.client@avarus.ru / TestClient_Pw_9x (set in iter_122). test.manager@avarus.ru / Tm-O56Zj6qYd0X3. No account passwords or roles were changed during this run.
seed_data_creation: Created and then CLEANED UP a throw-away admin user TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com. Did NOT delete any other data. Side effect on test.client@avarus.ru: a new balance top-up of +1 000 ₽ (card) is now completed and visible in /account history; a 1 500 ₽ crypto top-up request is marked failed; two earlier stale crypto-only pending top-up requests (1 500 ₽ each, created by the UI before the method-name filter fix) are still in the admin balance-topups list for test.client — they can be rejected by the admin UI if desired. One new TEST_ card-paid order was placed by test.client (still 'awaits requisites' — the admin can issue or cancel it).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test.client@avarus.ru password remains 'TestClient_Pw_9x'. Admin password is in $ADMIN_PASSWORD env. BalanceTopups.js treats method==='card' as the only requisites-bearing method (crypto stored as 'crypto_eth'/'crypto_bsc' etc — OK with current code). The one open UX item is LoginPage swallowing the 429 message. Backend lockout is confirmed working at request 11 (10 fails window).
rca of the issue: Login lockout UX miss — LoginPage.handleSubmit catch block ignores err.response.data.detail and always shows 'Неверный email или пароль'. Server correctly returns 429 with 'Слишком много попыток входа. Попробуйте через 15 минут.' at the 11th failed attempt. Fix: toast.error(err?.response?.data?.detail || 'Неверный email или пароль').
